description: This file implements a FAPI-to-PHY fast path translator for 5G NR, handling downlink and uplink message translation, validation, and processing, including resource management and slot control.

classes.name: error_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy class implementing error_indication_notifier interface with empty on_error_indication method.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator
classes.description: Main class handling translation and processing of FAPI messages to PHY layer, managing slots, controllers, and PDUs.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller
classes.description: Handles resource grid allocation and downlink processing for a specific slot.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller_manager
classes.description: Manages controllers for multiple slots, providing get, release, and acquire functionalities.

classes.name: downlink_pdus
classes.description: Struct holding vectors of downlink PHY PDUs for various channels.

classes.name: uplink_pdus
classes.description: Struct holding vectors of uplink PHY PDUs for various channels.

methods.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the translator with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller::slot_based_upper_phy_controller
methods.description: Constructor allocating resource grid and configuring downlink processor for a slot.

methods.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller::operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator for slot controller.

methods.name: generate_csi_re_pattern_list
methods.description: Generates list of RE patterns for CSI-RS PDUs in DL TTI request.

methods.name: translate_dl_tti_pdus_to_phy_pdus
methods.description: Translates and validates DL TTI PDUs from FAPI to PHY format, returning expected structure.

methods.name: send_dl_tti_request
methods.description: Processes and translates DL TTI request, manages slot controllers, and dispatches PDUs.

methods.name: is_pucch_pdu_valid
methods.description: Validates PUCCH PDU using uplink PDU validator.

methods.name: get_prach_dectector_config_from
methods.description: Creates PRACH detector configuration from buffer context.

methods.name: translate_ul_tti_pdus_to_phy_pdus
methods.description: Translates and validates UL TTI PDUs from FAPI to PHY format.

methods.name: send_ul_tti_request
methods.description: Processes UL TTI request, manages slot controllers, and queues PDUs.

methods.name: send_ul_dci_request
methods.description: Processes UL DCI request, validates PDUs, and dispatches to controller.

methods.name: send_tx_data_request
methods.description: Processes TX data request, validates, and dispatches PDSCH PDUs.

methods.name: on_last_message
methods.description: Releases slot controller for a given slot.

methods.name: handle_new_slot
methods.description: Updates current slot and logger context for a new slot.

methods.name: is_message_in_time
methods.description: Checks if a message's slot is within acceptable timing window.

methods.name: get_controller
methods.description: Retrieves or acquires a slot controller.

methods.name: acquire_controller
methods.description: Creates and returns a new slot controller for a slot.

methods.name: slot_based_upper_phy_controller_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing slot controller manager with pools and configuration.
